recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF). Place the title 'Matrix Notation for Linear Regression and Classification (N- Samples)' as one bold sans-serif text line, 30-34 pt, at top-left (x 3-80%, y 3-12%): color the word 'Matrix' blue (#0000FF) and all remaining words black (#000000).
2. Draw a filled yellow (#FFFF00) circle at top-right (x 92-98%, y 2-9%) and center the black (#000000) numeral '3' inside it (slide-number badge).
3. Place the text 'N Training Samples' in red (#FF0000) at left-middle (x 4-18%, y 22-30%), vertically aligned with the top matrix box.
4. Draw a gray (#808080)-bordered rectangle at top-center (x 15-73%, y 14-45%) as the top matrix-notation box. Inside it, build a column-wise matrix: header 'X_1' on a yellow (#FFFF99) highlight, header 'X_2' on a cyan (#CCFFFF) highlight, a dotted ellipsis between them, and header 'X_n' on a pink (#FFC0CB) highlight. Under 'X_1' stack x_11, x_12, ..., x_1d; under 'X_2' stack x_21, x_22, ..., x_2d; under 'X_n' stack x_n1, x_n2, ..., x_nd (black #000000, italic variables with subscripts). Draw one horizontal black (#000000) line under the entries and place the red (#FF0000) labels y_1, y_2, ..., y_n in a bottom row, one under each column.
5. Draw a blue (#0000FF)-bordered highlight box at top-right (x 74-96%, y 14-35%). Inside it place the red (#FF0000) italic heading 'Remember' and, below it, the black (#000000) equation 'y = W^T X = X^T W' with both W's underlined.
6. Draw a black (#000000)-bordered highlight box at right-middle (x 74-96%, y 39-48%) containing the single line 'In General: N >>> d': render 'In General:' in black (#000000) and 'N', '>>>', 'd' in red (#FF0000).
7. Draw a gray (#808080)-bordered rectangle at bottom-left (x 3-45%, y 55-90%) as the expanded-equation box. Inside it place, left to right: a bracketed column vector [y_1; y_2; ...; y_n] with the red (#FF0000) subscript 'N x 1'; an equals sign; a bracketed matrix whose first column is all 1s and whose visible cells are row 1: 1, x_11, x_12, ...., x_1d; row 2: 1, x_21, x_22, ...., x_2d; an ellipsis row: 1, ...., ...., ...., ....; row n: 1, x_n1, x_n2, ...., x_nd (all black #000000); then a bracketed weight vector [b; w_1; w_2; ...; w_d] with 'b' in blue (#0000FF), w_1 through w_d in black (#000000), and the red (#FF0000) subscript 'd+1 x 1'.
8. Draw a gray (#808080) right-pointing arrow at bottom-center (x 45-49%, y 68-74%) pointing from the bottom-left box to the bottom-right box.
9. Draw a gray (#808080)-bordered rectangle at bottom-right (x 49-96%, y 55-90%) as the compact-form box. Inside it place three black (#000000) lines: line 1: 'Y = X W' with Y, X, and W underlined; line 2: 'Where: X_(N x d+1) is a matrix' with X underlined; line 3: 'Y_(N x 1) is labels vector' with Y underlined.
10. Apply global typography: sans-serif font everywhere; bold weight only for the title; italic math variables with true subscripts at smaller size; keep every matrix column vertically aligned; use no bullet numbering anywhere on the slide.
